Bookmark management · API integration · Observability

SaveStack

A bookmark manager for X / Twitter that actually keeps up with your saves. Syncs bookmarks automatically, organizes them with AI-generated tags and folders, and delivers weekly digests to WhatsApp or Telegram — so nothing you saved gets buried and forgotten.

Built on a production-grade stack with a hardened VPS deployment, OTel observability across the API and worker layers, and a two-mode sync architecture — frontsync for continuous updates and backfill for historical recovery.

  • OAuth2 PKCE token lifecycle, frontsync / backfill pagination architecture
  • OpenTelemetry + Loki + Grafana + Tempo + Prometheus
  • Docker Compose, Nginx, Certbot TLS, Cloudflare DNS
  • Structlog — structured JSON logging
